summary: TriLinc Global Impact Fund LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to provide a routine portfolio update as of May 31, 2026. The filing discloses portfolio assets of approximately $283 million, a weighted average loan size of $10 million, and a weighted average duration of 0.4 years. It notes aggregate investments of $1.210 billion across 103 borrowers and $905.7 million in repayments. There is no transaction, no structural change, and no special situation event described. This is merely an operational business update, not an event-driven special situation. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
